children: Australian stocks look set to edge higher at the open, with trading volumes muted following the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday. ASX futures are up by less than 0.2% ahead of Friday's open, suggesting that the S&P/ASX 200 will consolidate its 2% rise so far this week. The benchmark index hit a six-month closing low Monday, before rallying alongside U.S. equities. Ahead of the open, Macquarie Group said the CEO of its challenger retail bank will retire in early 2027. QBE Insurance reiterated its annual outlook. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
